articles.summary: Seadrill Limited (“Seadrill” or the “Company”) (NYSE: SDRL) today announced its third quarter 2026 results. Highlights Secured contract awards and extensions in Indonesia, Malaysia, Angola, and the U.S. Gulf, adding approximately $800 million of Total Contract Value (1) subsequent to the August fleet status report. Generated $195 million of Net cash provided by operating activities, $179 million of Free Cash Flow (2) , and repurchased approximately $22 million of shares in the third quarter. Reported Net loss of $30 million, which includes the impact of a legal provision booked in the third quarter, and Adjusted EBITDA (2) of $121 million. articles.title: Seadrill Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results
